summary: Show concise upgrade plans and compatibility-specific installer guidance
details: The installer now starts existing-node upgrades with upgrade-plan and distinguishes compatible activation, explicit rebuild/reset, blocked plans and interrupted-operation recovery.

Human-readable upgrade previews use a component table and deduplicated change summary, with full paths and hashes available through --details. The complete --json plan and compatibility decisions are unchanged.

Preview recommendations follow the plan and saved operation state, preserve explicitly selected kit/configuration/source paths, and do not execute node operations. Blocked plans never recommend activation or rebuild execution.
